[Come along to Nuneaton Museum & Art Gallery to see a brilliant display of textile talent!]

The exhibition runs until Saturday, 7 November, at Nuneaton Museum & Art Gallery and features the work of the Midlands Textile Forum.

…

It has tripled in size since and has exhibited in places like NSA Gallery (Nottingham), Nature in Art (Gloucestershire) and the Town Hall in Ledbury.

…

The Exhibition is textile-based artwork – print, stitch, weave etc, using various materials and techniques, with an emphasis on creativity, experimentation and each member’s own interpretation of the exhibition title.
